correctness.rationale: The exact proof derives the full Gram normalization from C²=−pI. The class spectra, strict rank threshold, five-column restricted-isometry norm and endpoint p=7 all follow. Standalone checker independently verifies 1024 sign patterns and five-subset counts and spectral representatives for p=7,11,19,23,31; finite checks are not used for the infinite proof.
